concerns.text: FR-016 (VIF > 5 removal) and SC-010 are covered by tasks T200_vif_removal and T200_vif_verify, but these tasks are marked as unchecked (not implemented). The pipeline cannot satisfy the requirement to remove high-VIF descriptors before training without these tasks being executed.

FR-001 (Zenodo download) is covered by T140, but T140 depends on T007 (config setup). T007 is marked [X] (done), but T140 itself is marked [X] (done) while T008 (load raw data) is marked [ ] (pending). The flow is broken: T140 claims to download, but T008 (which loads the result) is not ready, and T098 (validation) is also pending. The spec requires the dataset to be downloaded AND validated before proceeding, but the task chain is incomplete.

FR-009 (abort on missing fields) is covered by T009a, but T009a depends on T009 (preprocessor), which depends on T008 (load raw data). T008 is marked [ ] (pending). Without T008, the preprocessor cannot run, and FR-009 cannot be tested or satisfied.

FR-018 (validate all artifacts) is covered by T200_schema_validation, but this task depends on 'all artifact-producing tasks'. Several artifact-producing tasks (T008, T098, T100, T101) are marked [ ] (pending) or have missing artifacts. The comprehensive validation gate cannot be executed until all upstream tasks are complete.

Task T127 references 'data/raw/heas_raw.csv' and requires a checksum match, but the file is missing (as noted in the analyze report). The task assumes the file exists to validate it, creating a logical gap. A task to generate or simulate the file for testing purposes is missing, making FR-009 untestable.

Task T016_update_use_cleaned depends on T200_vif_removal, but T200_vif_removal is unchecked. The training pipeline (T016) is not explicitly updated to use the cleaned file until this dependent task is executed, creating a workflow gap.
